name: mcp-open-library

tools.name: search_books
tools.description: Search Open Library across titles, authors, subjects, places, people, publishers and ISBNs. Provide at least one search criterion: q, title, author, subject, place, person, publisher, isbn; combining several narrows the search. Returns at most `limit` results (default 10) together with `num_found`, the total number of matches; page through them with `offset`. Each result carries `best_edition` — one edition of the work, with its `isbn_13`/`isbn_10` where Open Library has them, and its `edition_key`, which can be passed to `get_book_by_id` as `{ idType: "olid" }` for that edition's full record.

q.description: Free-form query searched across all fields. Supports Solr syntax, e.g. `subject:cyberpunk AND first_publish_year:[1980 TO 1990]`.

place.description: Search by a place the book is about.

person.description: Search by a person the book is about.

language.description: Restrict results to a language, as a 3-letter MARC code (e.g. eng, fre, spa).

sort.description: Result ordering. Omit for relevance. `new`/`old` order by first publication date, `rating` by average rating.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-50, default 10).

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging through the total reported as num_found (0-1000, default 0).

tools.name: get_book_by_title
tools.description: Search for a book by its title on Open Library. Returns at most `limit` results (default 10) together with `num_found`, the total number of matches; page through them with `offset`. Each result carries `best_edition` — one edition of the work, with its `isbn_13`/`isbn_10` where Open Library has them, and its `edition_key`, which can be passed to `get_book_by_id` as `{ idType: "olid" }` for that edition's full record.

title.description: The title of the book to search for.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-50, default 10).

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging through the total reported as num_found (0-1000, default 0).

tools.name: get_book_by_id
tools.description: Get detailed information about a book using its identifier (ISBN, LCCN, OCLC, OLID).

idType.description: The type of identifier used (isbn, lccn, oclc, olid). Case-insensitive.

tools.name: get_authors_by_name
tools.description: Search for author information on Open Library. Returns at most `limit` authors (default 10) together with `num_found`, the total number of matches; page through them with `offset`. Each result's `key` can be passed to `get_author_info` for that author's full record.

name.description: The name of the author to search for.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-50, default 10).

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging through the total reported as num_found (0-1000, default 0).

tools.name: get_author_info
tools.description: Get detailed information for a specific author using their Open Library Author Key (e.g. OL23919A).

author_key.description: The Open Library key for the author (e.g., OL23919A).

tools.name: get_author_photo
tools.description: Get the URL for an author's photo using their Open Library Author ID (OLID e.g. OL23919A). Reports when no photo exists rather than returning a URL to a blank placeholder.

olid.description: The Open Library Author ID (OLID) for the author (e.g. OL23919A).

tools.name: get_book_cover
tools.description: Get the URL for a book's cover image using a key (ISBN, OCLC, LCCN, OLID, ID) and value. Reports when no cover exists rather than returning a URL to a blank placeholder.

key.description: The type of identifier used (ISBN, OCLC, LCCN, OLID, ID). ID is Open Library's internal cover ID.

size.description: The desired size of the cover (S, M, or L). Defaults to L.

stderr: Open Library MCP server running on stdio
